result.stdout:
Usage: ids [options]

Cross-platform identifier generator — UUID v4, UUID v7, ULID, NanoID.

Options:
  -u, --uppercase   Uppercase UUID hex output
  -t, --type TYPE   Identifier type: uuid4, uuid7, ulid, nanoid (default: uuid7)
  -n, --count N     Number of IDs to generate (default: 1)
  -l, --length N    NanoID length (default: 21, nanoid only)
  --alphabet ALPHA  NanoID alphabet: url-safe, alphanum, hex, lower, upper (nanoid only)
  --format FORMAT   UUID shape: default, hex, braces, urn (uuid only)
  -h, --help        Show help
  --version         Show version
  --color           Force colored output
  --no-color        Disable colored output
  --json            JSON output
  --describe        Structured JSON metadata for AI agents

Exit Codes:
  0    Success
  1    Unexpected runtime error (e.g. OS CSPRNG failure, OOM)
  125  Usage error: bad flags, unknown value, or flag/type mismatch
